about_the_game:
A remote apartment. Its price is very cheap, attracting many people to live here. But the apartment is a mixed bag of good and bad, and no one cares about them. Here, people mysteriously disappear and die every day. The TV reports that a rabbit is committing crimes in the city. Are you saying all the crimes are caused by a rabbit? What is the truth? The protagonist explores this apartment, gradually lifting the veil of darkness. Fear shrouds the entire apartment. A family tragedy. What is the secret on the protagonist? What is the lonely old man waiting for in his rocking chair? The story is interlinked; the truth is even darker than imagined...

Core Gameplay:

Explore the apartment, uncover the truth, and evade monsters. Above all, survive. Beware of the rabbit lurking in the darkness, always ready to hunt. Solve mechanisms, use wires to restore power, and decipher various codes. Utilize the protagonist's phone to input different passwords, gaining access to information and fragments of the truth. As you delve deeper, the fear will gradually intensify.

Watch out for the Rabbit Monster — it can burrow through walls. Be cautious of the Vengeful Spirit; she may leap out and grab you at any moment. The little girl is friendly — though afraid of you, she will always sneakily help you.

The demo includes 5 map scenes. The protagonist explores the apartment and will venture into different residents' homes in search of secrets, encountering numerous mechanisms and puzzles along the way. Always stay alert for potential monsters and jump scares.


The game creates a pseudo-urban legend atmosphere with a realistic dark style. It incorporates puzzle-solving mechanics, including using wires to restore power and utilizing clues hidden on notes scattered throughout the map to crack passwords for various websites on the protagonist's phone — all gradually uncovering the truth behind the mystery.

The protagonist relies on medication to maintain sanity, so always ensure you have pills in your inventory. (Note: The medication mechanic is not yet implemented in the beta version.)

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A wave of disappearances. A rabbit blamed. As fear turns the apartment into a cage of paranoia, a venomous rumor takes hold. But dig deeper, and you'll find a truth far more sinister than any beast—a reality colder than murder.....
